answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: make each agent prove it keeps its own 20 GB block of data, built from its address so no two match, like the veins in a slab of marble. At random times a peer asks for bytes at a few chosen offsets and wants the reply within one second, too fast to rebuild the block on demand. An honest agent pays for one drive. A farm of 500 clones must keep 10 TB online, and any miss drops that clone past the reward horizon for 4 epochs. Clones can't share one drive, any more than quartz can pass for diamond.
